Sarah Shakespeare on Instagram: "✨Ramadan is a deeply significant month for Muslims worldwide, marked by fasting, prayer, reflection, and community. 
 ✨The name “Ramadan” itself comes from an Arabic root word “ramad,” which relates to intense heat, possibly reflecting the original timing of the observance in the Arabian Peninsula.
✨ It is believed that the month of Ramadan was a holy month to Arabs before Islam. During this month, tribal wars would stop, and people would retreat to meditate.
✨Key Aspects of Ramadan are; 
 Fasting (Sawm):
Muslims abstain from food and drink from dawn until sunset.
This practice is intended to foster self-discipline, empathy for those less fortunate, and increased spiritual awareness.
✨Prayer and Reflection:
Increased focus on prayer, including the special nightly prayers called Taraweeh.
Ramadan is a time for deep reflection, seeking forgiveness, and strengthening one’s connection with God.
✨ Community  and Charity:
 Ramadan emphasizes the importance of community, with families and friends often gathering for Iftar (the evening meal that breaks the fast).
 Charitable giving (Zakat) is also a significant aspect of Ramadan.
 ✨Lunar Calendar:
 The Islamic calendar is lunar, meaning Ramadan’s dates shift each year in relation to the Gregorian calendar.
In essence, Ramadan is a month of spiritual renewal, a time for Muslims to deepen their faith, strengthen their community bonds, and increase their acts of charity. ✨
✨Wishing all of my friends who will be celebrating Ramadan  between February 28th & March 30th a wonderful month ahead. 

#ramadan #ramadankareem #ramadanmubarak #celebrate #prayer #refection #community #charity #family #friends ✨"
